balls.text: SRH are all out for 159. A length ball outside off. Cummins looks to smash it down the ground but gets a top edge. Gurbaz comes forward a couple of steps and pouches it
a yorker. Cummins digs it out on the off side

a length ball outside off and Viyaskanth hits it over covers. There's not much power behind it which allows the batters to come back for the second. Harshit field it and casually lobs it towards the keeper. It's a wayward throw as well, which allows a third
full outside off and Cummins just opens the face of the bat to bisect the gap between backward point and short third for four
a top edge that flies over the keeper's head for a six. Was a length ball that Cummins looked to pull towards midwicket after clearing his front leg. It doesn't matter how they come - they all count
full and wide outside off. Cummins throws his bat at it but gets an inside edge into the ground and behind the stumps
a short ball. Viyaskanth hops and gets it down towards deep third off the shoulder of the bat
length ball around off. Cummins mistimes the pull towards wide long-on
goes for the yorker but it's just outside off. Cummins was looking to steer it towards deep third but gets an inside edge onto his leg
full outside off and spinning away. Cummins pushes it towards sweeper cover and keeps the strike with a single
a googly. Viyaskanth gets an inside edge onto the pads and collects a single on the leg side
full around off. Swept aerially towards deep square leg but it goes on the bounce to the fielder
full around off. Pushed towards long-off
a length ball around off. Cummins clears his front leg but ends up dragging it towards deep square leg
into the KKR dugout. A length ball around off and Cummins brings out the reverse shot
a slower one on this occasion. Cummins steers this one towards short third
an on-pace delivery, short outside off. Cummins backs away and steers it behind point for four
full outside off. Pushes at it and gets it towards deep third off the outer half of the bat
another slower one, this time just outside off. Cummins finally makes contact and steers it towards short third for one
116.8kph. Another length ball, another swing and a miss. Cummins is lucky it went just over the stumps
a length ball angling in. Cummins swings across and misses

another appeal for lbw and this time the impact in line of the stumps. The finger goes up but Bhuvi wants to review it. A length ball around off and spinning in to beat the inside edge as Bhuvi was looking to defend it on the front foot. The ball-tracking shows the impact was in front of the middle stump and it would have gone on to clip the leg bail - umpire's call there, which was out. SRH nine down
an appeal for lbw but the impact is outside off. A length ball outside off that Bhuvi looked to defend but got hit on the front pad instead
length ball around off. Cummins hacks it on the leg side but doesn't get the timing right. On the bounce to long-on. Varun isn't happy with the effort from Venkatesh but don't think it was a chance
length ball outside off. Cummins leaves it alone but it's just inside the wide guideline
length outside off. Steered towards the slip fielder
full around off. Cummins looks to slog it over midwicket but gets an inside edge onto the back leg
short of length at the stumps. Defended down
short and wide. Bhuvi goes for the cut but gets beaten
An offcutter, 114kph. Samad comes down the ground and looks to clear long-off. Doesn't get the required power behind it and Shreyas catches it carefully, just inside the boundary line
short of length at the batter. Cummins was backing away and manages to push it towards long-on
length ball outside off. Worked towards sweeper cover
length ball outside off. Pushes at it and gets beaten
length outside off. Cummins looks to run it down but gets beaten
length around off. Defended
length ball on the stumps. Turned towards square leg for a couple
and he is bowled first ball! A length ball around off that turns back sharply. Sanvir had no idea as he pushes at it and gets bowled through the gate. The middle stump is out of the ground

Excellent fielding from Russell. A length ball well outside off. Samad cuts it to the left of Russell at backward point who dives to his left, gets both hands to it, makes the stop and fires in the throw to the keeper even before he gets up. Both batters were looking for a single first before Tripathi realises Russell had made the stop. Too late by then and he finds himself stranded halfway while Samad runs past him. Gurbaz was first looking to throw at the bowler's end before realising it's a chance at his end. Breaks the wicket and Tripathi is distraught. He sits on the stairs to the dressing room, his face down in the lap
into the stands. Samad goes down the track and even though he didn't get to the pitch of the ball, the connection was so clean that the sound off the bat told you it was going all the way
full around off. Samad goes aerial towards long-on where Starc decided to paddle back and save the boundary instead of charging in and going for the catch
skips down the ground but gets too close to the ball. Pushes it towards long-off for one
length ball around off. Gives himself some room and opens the face of the bat to steer it towards backward point
length ball on the stumps. Flicked towards deep midwicket
down the track and takes it on the full. Looks to go hard at it but gets an outside edge that bounces towards short third
full around off and middle. Flicked in front of square leg
length ball but spinning down the leg side for a wide
length ball spinning in. Worked towards long-on
flatter and quicker. Tucked away towards midwicket
length ball on the pads. Pushed towards the bowler
length ball on the stumps. Defended towards short midwicket
a length ball around off and Samad needs no sighters. Muscles it over deep midwicket for a six
length ball on the stumps. Pushed towards the non-striker. Narine was a bit casual in stopping that and ends up conceding a single

A huge, huge moment in the game. A length ball at the stumps. Klaasen looks to go for a six but doesn't get the timing right. Rinku from deep midwicket runs to his right and catches it just inside the boundary line. He had to be mindful of the deep square leg fielder who was sprinting to his left
full around off. Flicked towards deep midwicket for one
a reverse sweep to bring up his fifty. It was a length ball on the stumps but Tripathi reverse his stance and hits it to the right of Russell at backward point
length outside off. Goes back and cuts it towards sweeper cover
length ball around off. Pushed through covers
an excellent yorker - 107kph. Tripathi can only dig it out back towards the bowler
length ball on the stumps. Pushed towards midwicket. And he has overstepped
length ball on the stumps. Pushed towards long-on
short outside off. Tripathi goes for the pull but gets a top edge. Luckily it falls safe near midwicket region, inside the 30-yard circle
another short ball. Tripathi leaps and ramps it over the keeper. He enjoys playing in the V behind the stumps
short and wide once again. Klaasen cuts it over cover this time. Only a single
short and wide and Klaasen isn't going to miss out on those. Cuts it up and over the backward point for a four
length ball on the stumps. Pushed towards long-on
length outside off and this is the Klaasen power. Forces it from the crease wide of Russell at long-off. He puts in a sprint and a dive but fails to get there in time

shouts of "catch it" as Klaasen goes aerial down the ground. It was a length ball around off, probably carrom. Klaasen didn't seem to have middled it, and it looked like Russell was in with a chance, only for the ball to clear him quite comfortably in the end
length ball around off. Backs away and forces it through extra cover. Comes back for the second as the ball goes to the left of Russell at long-off
swept along the ground from just outside off. A single to deep-backward square leg
full on the stumps. Tripathi jumps across and laps it over the keeper's head for a boundary
length ball spinning towards the pads. Flicked towards wide long-on
another slower one. Klaasen waits for it before pushing it towards long-on
115.7kph. Back to the slower one. Tripathi pushes it through covers for a single

another bouncer. Perhaps getting a bit predictable as Tripathi seemed to be waiting for it. Just opens the face of the bat to ramp it over the keeper's head for the first six of the night. Who would have thought it would come in the eighth over!
another short ball but well outside off. Too high, says the square leg umpire
length outside off. Cuts it towards deep point
115kph. A slower one from Rana. Tripathi was shuffling around the stumps before realising it's a slower ball. Steers it behind point for one
short outside off. Klaasen pulls it towards long-on

length ball at the stumps. Pushed back uppishly towards the bowler. It was to Narine's right, around knee height. He gets a hand on it but never looked like catching it. A single down the ground for Klaasen
length ball at the stumps. Flicked towards midwicket. The initial call was for two but Rinku charges towards the ball to keep it to one
a carrom ball around off. Pushed towards long-off
length ball turning in. Punched back towards the bowler who fumbles but no harm done
an offbreak from good length outside off. Tripathi with a late cut there which has been stopped by short third
full on the pads. Worked to the left of short fine leg
short of length outside off. Steered towards deep third
a bouncer outside off. Klaasen goes for the pull but fails to connect. A good overhead take by Gurbaz behind the stumps
length outside off. Punched towards cover
length ball but too much width. Klaasen throws his bat at it and gets a thick outside edge that flies past the slip fielder for four
length ball outside off. Cuts it behind point for one
A length ball around off. Pushed towards extra cover

played on! The middle stump is out of the ground. SRH in absolute trouble at 39 for 4. It was a length ball outside off - looked like a cross-seam delivery - that Shahbaz tried to dab towards deep third but ended up deflecting it onto his stumps
Starc has his second. A short ball outside off and Reddy goes for the pull, only to top-edge it. Gurbaz calls for it and settles under it behind the stumps
short of length outside off. Pushed towards cover
length ball around off. Tripathi stays leg side of the ball and somehow manages to flick it towards square leg
slightly fuller, slightly closer to the batter. Reddy punches it into the ground and collects as a single as the ball dribbles towards extra cover
a length ball outside off. Enough width for Reddy to free arms. Smashes it over cover for a one-bounce four
length ball on the pads. Flicked towards midwicket for a quick single. Russell attacks the ball and aims for a direct hit at the non-striker's end. He misses but I think the batter was safe anyway
length ball but way outside off and doesn't swing in. Reddy pulls out of the shot to collect a wide
length ball straying down the leg side. Flicked in front of square leg for a couple
shuffles around in the crease before backing away. Arora cramps him with a length ball. A single to mid-on
a short ball. Tripathi goes for the pull but fails to connect
this is better from Tripathi. He goes with the swing this time, flicking this full delivery over midwicket for four. And Arora has overstepped as well
length ball, swinging in to cramp Tripathi who defends it
Down the ground, giving himself some room at the same time. It's a length ball but the bounce means Tripathi gets it high on the bat. Luckily for him, it's just to the right of mid-off
length ball outside off. Steered towards cover-point
short of length. Left alone by Reddy

a searing yorker from Starc, on middle and leg. Tripathi jams his bat at it but it's not clear if it was pad first or bat first. The lbw appeal has been denied and KKR are not reviewing it. But replay shows the ball hit him flush on the front shoe. This would have been out on review
Tripathi does Tripathi. A length ball angling across. Tripathi moves across, gets low and scoops it past the diving keeper
full on the stumps. Pushed to the right of mid-on
length ball but way down the leg side
full outside off. Hits to the left of mid-off and hares down the other end for a single
short of length around off and jagging back in to hit Reddy high on the bat as he was looking to dab it down

Russell doesn't make the mistake Narine did. Full outside off, Abhishek looks to go aerial but fails to middle it. Russell at cover leaps, gets both hands to the ball and plucks it. SRH in early trouble
length ball around off. Pushed towards covers
length ball coming in. Tripathi opens the face of the bat to work it behind point
length outside off. Steered behind point; only one this time
down the track but it's too wide outside off. Abhishek lets it go
length outside off. Abhishek cuts it past point for a couple. Ramandeep made a good sliding stop in the deep

just evades the covers fielder. Full outside off - Starc is going for the swing - and Tripathi drives it in the air. Narine at cover was a touch late to react. A better, quicker response would have seen Tripathi walking back
length ball in the channel. Left alone
Starc goes for the yorker this time, on the off stump. Tripathi jams his bat at it and squeezes it out towards backward point where Ramandeep Singh misfields and gives away four runs
a length ball outside off and comes in for Tripathi. He comes forward and looks to defend. Gets an inside edge onto the front pad
Second successive duck for Head. A length ball this time and once again shaping away slightly. Head played all around it and got bowled. A huge wicket for KKR early on

Full outside off, and a hint of outswing. Head drives it towards covers. Abhishek was keen for a single but it went straight Shreyas Iyer who had an aim at the non-striker's end but missed. Abhishek, despite the dive, would have been in trouble

KKR make the final of IPL 2024 imperiously They have shellacked SRH, something that they've done previously. The last ball was full and outside off and full and S Iyer launched it on a bent knee, got it sailing over long-on. A big hug between the batters, Shah Rukh Khan is blowing kisses in the stands, the smiles in the KKR dugout can't be bigger.
S Iyer also gets to fifty in style. Raises his bat high as KKR's song goes loud and the fireworks off. Was a baby ball on leg that was slog swept
Overpitched on middle, S Iyer whips it aerially. No one at midwicket and it's in the gap between long-on and deep-mid
More punishment for Head. This was slot on leg and S Iyer slog swept it with the turn, sails over square leg

This is like Travis Head from the final. Stands tall and pulls it with disdain for a six over midwicket. Brings up his fifty too, he gives a thumbs up to the stands. This was a shortish ball that sat up
Makes room, almost too much, as the slower one is full and on fourth. V Iyer reaches out and smooshes it back to the bowler
Length on middle, whipped to deep square leg
Bumper at 128ks is at the chest but S Iyer has ample time to swivel-pull it in the gap behind square
Cuffed down the ground, not perfectly timed though. Long-off runs to the left and cuts it off. Was a length ball on the fuller side that Nitish tried muscling
Back of a length just outside off, guided to deep third
Full around off, pushed towards long-off
Turns it off the pads for a single around the corner
Misfield at short fine leg. Was a full ball down leg that S Iyer swept with bent legs. Didn't have time to get on one knee but enough to get the ball rolling
V Iyer continues trying to toy with Head but only lays glove on the ball with the attempted reverse sweep. He wanted to go square and far but got it nearby
Tries to whoosh it away but can't use the width on this length ball. Beatn comprehensively
Not that it'll change much. V Iyer goes back and powers a square drive in the gap.

Edge off the ramp goes to the deep-third fence. Was a shortish ball angling in from around the wicket, going over fifth, and S Iyer tried to go right over the keeper. Got an inside edge, from what it looked like to me. Harshth, our scorer, says that was intentional though

Slower full ball at the stumps is worked towards mid-on for a quick single. Direct hit at the striker's end but the only thing of note there is Nattu having to duck to avoid the ball. Poor fellow got floored trying to stop it in the follow-through too. He manages to smile at the end of it all though
V Iyer tries to hoist it across the line but gets no room and is hurried, ends up working the length ball angling in, to midwicket
Length around off, guided to deep third
Driven through the line, sails over mid-off and that sums up SRH's day.

Head drops at sitter point Resignation on the faces of the fielders. This was a bread-basket catch coming in at an easy pace. He buckled his hips and looked to take it with both hands but cramped himself instead. May have taken it too easily. Was a length ball that was square driven. Just spooned

A bit short, very flat and it's mullered in front of square. Cross-seam ball seemed to have slipped out. V Iyer transfers his weight back, gets his bat real high with the back-lift and powers it across the line
Full outside off, looked like shaped to sweep but decided to push it with an open face to cover
Works it around the corner, hits a gap to pick up two and bring up KKR's 100
Dances down and clips the slow length ball, which he turned into a full one, to long-on
Punches the fullish ball to long-off, off the back foot

Klaasen does amazingly to get a rebound catch, almost collides with midwicket running in, and might've dropped it too! He took the ball while falling but Tripathi ran into him and the gloves hit Tripathi's leg and he lost the ball. Unlucky pro max. Tripathi asks if he's okay - he is... physically at least. It was a length dart outside off that Shreyas went and indeed leant across to, for the paddle. Ball went onto the helmet and about 15 feet away, towards midwicket, before more tragedy struck SRH
Balloons up but lands safely at forward square leg. Was a bumper outside off that S Iyer tried bunt-pulling. An 11-run over and it brings the asking rate under 6 RPO
Into the pitch, pace-on, S Iyer guides it with ease. Waited for it to align with his shoulder and carved it wide of deep third
Makes room, gets followed again but can't get enough power behind the pull. He wanted to go squarer but helps it to long leg in the end
Yorker on leg and middle, made room and got the front leg up as he drove it to long-off
Cummins continues to get a drubbing as V Iyer makes room and heaves the slower shortish ball that followed him. Pulled it from around waist height in the gap in front of deep square leg
Shortish outside off, rides the bounce well and runs it - after ball passed him - to deep third
Goes back and flicks it to deep midwicket
Fullish length ball outside off, V Iyer goes square-on and windscreen-wipes it, away from the body, down the ground for a single
Punched to deep point. Flat length ball on fourth, 94ks
Slapped to deep midwicket

Looped up by the bowler and lumped away by the batter! Huge six over midwicket. 90ks legbreak outside off, full, V Iyer was getting onto one knee but not there yet as he met that with the slog sweep. 88 metres
Shortish ball around off is pulled to deep midwicket
Length outside off, guided to short third
V Iyer has flayed a 142ks ball that's almost full. Gets the cross bat out and smears it over mid-off, it almost felt like there was anger in the bat swing

Klaasen is convinced about the caught behind but the umpire doesn't move. SRH out of reviews of course. There was a sound but more like a bat flick. Was a shortish ball angling away that V Iyer limboed down to and tried ramping over the keeper. Got nothing on it, as Ultra-Edge confirms
No, this is outside off on a length and is guided to deep third
Cummins gets him second time around, goes into the pitch and has Narine hole out to deep midwicket. 143ks on a shortish length and it came u to rib-height

Finds the edge but it beats the keeper, too straight for the finest of deep thirds too! Would've been a high catch for first slip if there was one but Klaasen had to leap out and didn't lay glove on it. Was a shortish ball that Narine tried to flay square
Low full toss on middle, 138ks, Narine works the missed yorker to long-on. SRH take the timeout as soon as it becomes available
Narine nails the pull this time, pierces the gap between long-on and deep-mid. This was more shortish and the ball rose only around hip-height. Narine had a bit of room and eased into the heave
Change-up bumper is called wide. This was too high. Pace-on and right over the head, Narine swivelled and had his front foot up in the air, the bat came down early
Yorkers are keeping Narine quiet, but only when nailed of course as this was. It's at the stumps and is jammed in front
Low fully on leg, beats the flick and rolls off the pad towards cover

Bumper at 136ks hits him on the grill! Physio runs out for the concussion test. This was angling in and Narine tried to leather it square while swivelling, got hit on the side and the ball deflected to the off side. He's okay to go. Replay shows it actually hit him on the back of the lid, just at the base
Full outside off, clears the front leg and clatters it. Finds cover though. Not timed and Narine might've dinked his bat in the process
Hits high on the bat and the bottom hand comes off but the ball falls in front safely. Was a length ball around fourth that spat up a bit. V Iyer played it with a straightish bat
Bumper is ducked under. Not given wide
Test ball beats the batter for a change. It's still length at the top of the stumps, decks away just a bit and V Iyer tried to guide it from the crease. Ball beats the open-faced bat
Dances down and flays it over mid-off! Turned the length ball into a fullish one and lifted it from around knee-roll height with the cross-bat
Bhuvi's new-ball spell continues to contrast Starc's from the first innings. It's a bit down leg and helped fine
Fullish length ball just outside off, pushed towards cover point
Full and just outside leg, Narine's method of clearing the front leg and whipping it square goes against hit this time. Hit flush on the pad and rolls front
Wide bumper at 135ks, Narine looks to drag it across with the pull. Beaten
Similar line but from the top of a length. 135ks. Beats the flick and dribbles off the pad towards square leg
Bad ball. Glanced fine. Nattu wanted to york him, as Sunil Gavaskar mentions, and got the length on the half-volley area and the line just too wide.

Gurbaz holes out to cover and yells in frustration right away! He charged down, as he often has tonight, and tried to carve it on the up. But the ball spooned off the bottom of the bat and went straight towards Viyaskanth's chest. Gurbaz might have made a bit too much room too. SRH have an opening but is it already too late?
Wide on a length, tries to slash it square. Beaten
Full on off, whipped wide of midwicket. Tripathi runs to the left from long-on and keeps it to two
Slow on a length outside off, chopped to point

Heaved wide of mid-on! Gurbaz was camping on the back foot, probably bet on Bhuvi not going full after the last ball. It was slightly back of a length and a bit outside off, came at a good pace onto pad and was duly slapped
Oh my gawd, Gurbaz has smoked Bhuvi like he were a spinner. Knuckle ball on a fullish length, angling in, but it don't matter. Gurbaz charged down and whooshed it through the line, six over long-on
Yorker on fifth, crouches and jams it to long-on. 139ks

Another review for an lbw. Slower one was swinging in, going down leg is a danger but Bhuvi is convinced and SRH will take it upstairs. Third ump says they're prioritising ball tracking cos they have additional information (ball was away enough from the bat as Narine tried whipping to midwicket)... and it's pitching ever so slightly outside leg. SRH out of reviews after 13 legal balls!
Shortish on fifth, defended off the back foot to backward point. 20 off the over, couldn't have been a better start for KKR. They've had two of those in the match
Comes forward and tries helping it away, this one's down leg though

Six over third off the edge - that's how small the boundary is. 140ks length ball just outside off, Gurbaz was a couple metres out of the crease and had a whoosh with the cross-bat, got it fine and 59 metres far

Did Gurbaz get too far across? Cummins appeals for lbw but it's not given. He checks with Klaasen, who's down for a little while, and Cummins throws a hail mary despite not getting a response. Review taken. Was a length ball that pitched just outside off. Gurbaz was out to fourth stump and missed the glance, got hit on the inner-edge of the knee-roll. Hawk-Eye predicts the angle to have been too sharp - missing leg. Review gone
More like it from Cummins, goes short and at the body. Narine can't control the pull but the top edge falls safely in the empty acreage at square leg. Stopped in the deep
Cummins goes full and is punished again, whipped wide of mid-on. Narine clears the front leg a bit, goes high with the back-lift and works it away with power
No surprises from Narine, clears the front leg and thrashes it, straight of mid-off. This was full and just outside off, he stood tall and had a free swing. Catchable height but also in the gap
Fullish around sixth, 139ks, driven with the swing to cover
Fullish around off, defended late. Single behind point
Was there an edge? No... Bhuvi pitches it and keeps it wide, got it swinging away, Gurbaz goes for the slashing cover drive and misses. Ball deflects off Klaasen's gloves and went low to first slip
Bhuvi starts from a wide line again but gets it to swing back in. Gurbaz was across and punched it defensively, to the bowler
Too wide and it's driven sweetly. This was fullish and the swing took it further away, Gurbaz maintained his balance perfectly this time
Gurbaz walks down and across straight away, almost walks into the ball and loses balance. He manages to nurdle it with a closed face to midwicket
